name: Meteorite Flare
body:
Price 50 gp; Slot —; Weight 1 lb.; Capacity none; Usage none

DESCRIPTION

This 18-inch metal rod has a thin, beaded chain protruding from one end, while the other end is hollow and sealed with wax.

The hollow end has a vaguely metallic scent tinged with a hint of combustible residue. Pulling the chain on a meteorite flare launches sparkling pea-sized object hundreds of feet into the air, glowing like a shooting star. Meteorite flares can be used as emergency signals or to send secret messages, though the signal is quite subtle unless an individual is deliberately looking for it. Identifying a meteorite flare for what it is requires a DC 20 Perception check; creatures specifically watching for a meteorite flare gain a +10 bonus on this check. A single flare tube carries a total of 10 flares. A meteorite flare cannot be used as a weapon.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Technological Item; Equipment production lab; Craft DC 18; Cost 25 gp
